name: Steam
author: blip
description: Steam in your bar: the store with in-widget store pages, recent games, your library, downloads and friends with chat

barWidget.description: Store, recent games, library, downloads and friends

schema.label: Install new games to
schema.description: Part of the Steam library folder's path to install into when you click an uninstalled game (e.g. GAMES for /run/media/you/GAMES/SteamLibrary). Empty uses Steam's default folder. Each row's drive buttons can pick another.

schema.label: Steam Web API key (optional)
schema.description: From steamcommunity.com/dev/apikey. With a key, Friends shows your exact friend list and live status in one quick request; without one, status is read from each friend's public profile a few at a time.
